frozen_hypothesis: normalised score/SVI keep fixed boundaries; funding gate uses previous-90-event robust-z raw boundary median90 + c*1.4826*MAD90 (c in {-0.5,0}); only target vol adapts (trailing sigma_ann quantile or V-ENS mean); 0.5 F42 + 0.5 S180 long ensemble dilutes long profit concentration; maker 4 bps rt

short.vol: mean of min(1,Q/sigma) for W180-P50, W180-P65, W365-P50, W365-P65; any NaN -> flat

params.sigma: std of previous 180 4h log returns, current excluded; sigma_ann=sigma4*sqrt(6*365)

funding_semantics: strict: latest event j with funding_time < T; threshold sample = previous 90 events (event j excluded), min 30 finite
mad0_rule: MAD90 == 0 -> threshold = median90 (scale-degenerate raw boundary collapses to the median; not a defined robust-z). DEV MAD0 decisions 4046/14832, TEST 0
decision_time: UTC 00/04/08/12/16/20; dec4 = 239 + 240k from 2020-01-01 00:00; order time T = closed 4h bar open + 1m (paper records decision_time / exit_decision_time = research bar time + 1m, Codex HIGH fix)

execution.entry: maker limit 2 bps (long floor(close*(1-0.0002)/0.1)*0.1, short ceil(close*(1+0.0002)/0.1)*0.1), TTL 60 1m bars, 0.5 bp trade-through, gap-through rejects
execution.exit: target != held side -> passive 2 bps favourable quote, requote every 60m at new close, 0.5 bp penetration, until filled; new decisions ignored while exit pending; no immediate reversal
execution.sizing: weight frozen at entry decision until exit
execution.cost: maker 4 bps round trip x weight, slippage 0, PESS funding (actual events), 1m MTM

capital: common NAV; each sleeve <= 1x, gross <= 2x (net = wL - wS); P&L is the plain sum of sleeve bps of NAV; no x3 overlay
state_machines: two independent sleeves (separate batch-2 simulate runs on the sleeve-masked target)
